The system should: • Accept the total number of orders (limit) as input. • Use two threads, each representing a processor (Processor-I and Processor-2), to alternately process orders. • Ensure the processing sequence is maintained, and all orders are accounted for, even when the number of orders is odd. • At the end of the program, display the total number of processed orders to confirm that no order has been missed. Ensure thread synchronization to handle shared resources correctly.
inputFormat: The input consists of a single integer, limit, representing the total number of orders.
